description: A tag test on a reference reads the tags of its completed constituent: w⊇~a holds for the w over X, which the rule tags a, and w⊉~a for the w over Y, although the token Y carries a (engine §2, §4).
grammar:
%rule text [{p}]
%rule p hit | miss
%rule hit w⊇~a
%rule miss w⊉~a
%rule w X <~a> | Y <~b>
